footprint: KSA: 489 branches, 22 retail service centres and 91 QuickPay remittance centres (30 Jun 2026); 3,771 ATMs. Overseas wholesale branches in Bahrain, UAE (Downtown Dubai), Qatar and Singapore; subsidiaries in Turkey (TFKB, 224 branches) and Pakistan (SBL, 77 branches); offices in Shanghai and Seoul; 'presence in 9 countries' (2Q26 presentation). customer_segments: Retail: mass, affluent (Wessam Gold, Wessam Platinum), Elite and Private Banking clients, plus micro-businesses; NEO digital bank customers. Digital ventures: NEO lifestyle digital bank and POS business.

capabilities.wealth_summary: SNB runs wealth through two layers. In the bank, Retail serves mass, affluent and private clients with Shariah-compliant products: Wessam Gold (from SAR 100k relationship), Wessam Platinum (SAR 500k; dedicated RM and wealth manager), the Elite Program (SAR 1.5m) and SNB Private Banking (threshold not published; dedicated RM, concierge, mutual funds, local and international trading, Khayrat). Private-banking gross financing reached SAR 37.7bn at 30 Jun 2026 (+18% YTD), and in Aug 2026 SNB launched the World Legend Mastercard for private-banking clients. Investment products are made and executed by the 100% subsidiary SNB Capital (asset-management AUM SAR 263.0bn at end-2025; 279bn and #1 with 22% share at 1Q26; #1 broker with 14% of H1 2026 value traded), whose apps (SNB Capital app, AlAhli Tadawul) sit outside the SNB Mobile banking app. The 2025-27 strategy calls for a 'differentiated value proposition in HNW and Affluent' and an 'SNB Capital fee focus', and AR 2025 says a robo-advisory platform is being added to Wealth Management.

private_banking.detail: SNB Private Banking ('Retail Private Banking'): dedicated RM, customised investment strategy, local and international trading, diversified mutual funds, Khayrat, FX and credit facilities to support investment activity, 24/7 concierge, private-banking branches. Gross private-banking financing SAR 37.7bn at 30 Jun 2026. World Legend Mastercard for private-banking clients launched Aug 2026 with Mastercard (includes access to economic forums with Bloomberg). The brand 'AlAhli Private' was not found.

asset_management.detail: Through SNB Capital (100%, CMA-licensed): asset-management-division AUM SAR 262,977m at 31 Dec 2025; SAR 279bn at 1Q26 (22% of KSA, #1). Mostly Shariah-compliant public funds (equity, sukuk, money market, multi-asset, MSCI Islamic index funds, REITs, waqf funds), private real-estate funds and SNB Capital (DIFC) private funds. See sa-snb-capital.

brokerage.detail: Through SNB Capital: local trading (AlAhli Tadawul online and mobile, IVR, VIP lounges) and international trading via Alahlitadawul.com registration; #1 by H1 2026 value traded (SAR 175bn, 14%); international brokerage nearly USD 8bn traded in 2025 (+44%). The bank website links 'AlAhli Tadawul' and 'AlAhli Capital' for brokerage.

digital_investing.detail: Investing is in separate SNB Capital channels (SNB Capital app, AlAhli Tadawul, SNB Capital Global apps). In the SNB Mobile banking app, investment-type features found are the Gold Account (also on AlAhliOnline) and Khayrat AlAhli (product page in the business-banking section: minimum 100,000, or 25,000 via SNB Mobile); no in-app securities or fund trading found on the SNB Mobile page. Retail digital sales share 78% (2025) and 93% digitally active customers.

advisory.detail: Private Banking Investment: investment advice and customised strategy from a dedicated RM. Wessam Platinum includes an 'experienced wealth manager'. SNB Capital provides investment advisory and wealth managers' coverage (see sa-snb-capital).

discretionary.detail: Through SNB Capital's Discretionary Portfolio Management service (see sa-snb-capital). No bank-level discretionary mandate found.

model_portfolios_robo.detail: Through SNB Capital: Idikhari goal-based savings platform in the SNB Capital app recommends one Shariah-compliant fund per plan (three multi-asset risk funds or a money-market fund) and automates contributions. AR 2025: 'Asset Management is a core contributor to the robo-advisory platform which is being added to the portfolio of Wealth Management services'. No robo or model-portfolio service in the SNB Mobile app found.

funds_platform.detail: Private banking offers 'diversified mutual funds'; the range found is SNB Capital's own funds. No third-party fund shelf or platform provider found on SNB or SNB Capital pages.

structured_products.detail: Shariah-compliant 'Structured Investment Products' built on structured AlKhairaat, giving exposure to FX, precious metals and Shariah-compliant equity indices; an enhanced deposit alternative to structured deposits; Elite members get custom Khayrat products 'with capital protection possibility'.

private_markets.detail: Through SNB Capital: private real-estate funds, SNB Capital (DIFC) private funds (private credit, PE, aviation, GP stakes), Eastgate MENA Direct Equity L.P. (100% group subsidiary), and a Feb 2026 Investcorp partnership covering alternatives. See sa-snb-capital.

islamic_wealth.detail: Retail Banking offers 'a comprehensive suite of Shariah-compliant products'; Shariah-compliant deposits SAR 537bn of 698bn (30 Jun 2026); Khayrat AlAhli commodity-Murabaha deposits; Shariah-compliant structured products; SNB Capital's public funds are all Shariah-compliant. Shariah Committee established 1996.
